calls.video_title: Interesting Update for Robinhood Stock Investors | HOOD Stock Analysis
calls.thesis: Reiterates his hold: not a buying opportunity yet — record trading and prediction markets (+500%) show growth, but at $91.60 the price already reflects those prospects and more.
calls.base_case: Fair value $58 vs $91.60 — overvalued; 20% EPS growth over coming years looks reasonable.
calls.bull_case: Agentic trading ($250M already allocated) and new features keep engagement and account growth rising.
calls.bear_case: Cyclical: crypto revenue plunged 55% to $120M as activity tracked Bitcoin's 2026 drop, and trading collapses when markets fall.
